title: Vectorworks Architect workflows and connector status
description: Explore Vectorworks Architect workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Nemetschek Group

Vectorworks Architect

Vectorworks Architect combines design modelling, BIM data and architectural documentation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Develop a spatial concept

Begin with the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended Vectorworks Architect preview, develop a spatial concept; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Attach BIM information

Use the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended Vectorworks Architect preview, attach BIM information; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Publish plans and sections

Start from the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended Vectorworks Architect preview, publish plans and sections; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
